authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3906.1 khura explicitly gives Kalasha and Maiya khur “foot”, alongside the hoof-to-foot extension across Dardic. The survey leg/foot responses belong to that local limb family, not the separate khuḍa branch. Joint comparison: Gaw kʰūr “leg” matches reviewed Kal kʰūr “leg” (f_722dftnrlogju). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
